contentHtml:
Heaven on Earth Cake comes together with a moist vanilla crumb and a layer of tangy coconut cream frosting. Fluffy sponge cake flavored with orange juice and cinnamon is topped with smooth buttercream and toasted almonds. Each bite is soft and rich, with fresh berries adding contrast and a touch of almond extract rounding out the flavor. Easy to make and full of comfort, this dessert delivers simple, satisfying sweetness without the need for any added spirits.

Why You’ll Love This Heaven on Earth Cake

  • It’s incredibly moist and fluffy, making every bite a delight.
  • Simple ingredients come together for a decadent dessert experience.
  • Perfect for any occasion, from casual gatherings to special celebrations.
  • Easy to make, even for novice bakers, ensuring success every time.
  • It’s a crowd-pleaser that will leave your guests asking for the recipe!

Heaven on Earth Cake

Indulge in our Easy Heaven on Earth Cake recipe! 🍰 Moist, decadent, and perfect for any occasion. Discover your new favorite dessert!
Print Recipe Pin Recipe
Prep Time 20 minutes mins
Cook Time 35 minutes mins
chilling 30 minutes mins
Total Time 1 hour hr 25 minutes mins
Servings: 12 servings
Course: Dessert
Cuisine: American
Calories: 350
Ingredients Equipment Method Notes

Ingredients
  

Cake Ingredients
  • 2 cups all-purpose flour for the cake base
  • 1.5 cups granulated sugar to sweeten
  • 1 cup unsalted butter softened for creaminess
  • 4 large eggs for structure
  • 1 cup milk makes it moist
  • 2 tsp vanilla extract for flavor
  • 2 tsp baking powder helps it rise
  • 0.5 tsp salt balances sweetness
  • 1 cup shredded coconut adds texture and flavor
  • 1 cup chopped almonds for crunch
  • 1 cup white chocolate chips for indulgent sweetness
Frosting Ingredients
  • 1 cup heavy cream for whipped topping
  • 1 cup powdered sugar to sweeten the cream
  • 4 oz cream cheese softened for richness

Equipment

  • 1 9×13-inch baking pan Greased and floured for easy removal
  • 1 Mixing bowl For mixing ingredients
  • 1 whisk For mixing dry ingredients
  • 1 Spatula For smoothing batter and frosting

Method
 

Preparation Steps
  1. Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour a 9×13 inch baking pan to ensure your cake comes out easily.
  2. In a bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt. This will be the base of your cake.
  3. In a separate bowl, cream together the butter and granulated sugar until the mixture is light and fluffy. This step adds air and sweetness!
  4. Add the eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition. Stir in the vanilla extract for that lovely flavor.
  5. Alternately add the dry ingredients and milk to the butter mixture, starting and ending with the dry ingredients. Mix until just combined.
  6. Gently fold in the shredded coconut, chopped almonds, and white chocolate chips. This adds texture and flavor!
  7. Pour the batter into the prepared pan and smooth the top with a spatula. Make it look nice!
  8. Bake for 30-35 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Your kitchen will smell amazing!
  9. While the cake is baking, make the frosting by beating heavy cream, powdered sugar, and cream cheese until stiff peaks form. This will be the cherry on top!
  10. Allow the cake to cool completely, then spread the frosting evenly over the top. Make it look pretty!
  11. Garnish with extra coconut, almonds, and white chocolate shavings for that extra touch of elegance.
  12. Chill the cake for 30 minutes before slicing and serving. Enjoy your heavenly creation!

How to Make Heaven on Earth Cake

This delightful Heaven on Earth Cake is a moist and decadent dessert that will leave you and your guests in bliss. With a preparation time of about 20 minutes, a cooking time of 30-35 minutes, and an additional chilling time of 30 minutes, you’ll have a heavenly treat ready to impress!

Step 1: Preheat the Oven

Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour a 9×13 inch baking pan to ensure your cake comes out easily.

Step 2: Mix Dry Ingredients

In a bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt. This will be the base of your cake.

Step 3: Cream Butter and Sugar

In a separate bowl, cream together the butter and granulated sugar until the mixture is light and fluffy. This step adds air and sweetness!

Step 4: Add Eggs and Vanilla

Add the eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition. Stir in the vanilla extract for that lovely flavor.

Step 5: Combine Ingredients

Alternately add the dry ingredients and milk to the butter mixture, starting and ending with the dry ingredients. Mix until just combined.

Step 6: Fold in Extras

Gently fold in the shredded coconut, chopped almonds, and white chocolate chips. This adds texture and flavor!

Step 7: Pour Batter

Pour the batter into the prepared pan and smooth the top with a spatula. Make it look nice!

Step 8: Bake the Cake

Bake for 30-35 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Your kitchen will smell amazing!

Step 9: Make the Frosting

While the cake is baking, make the frosting by beating heavy cream, powdered sugar, and cream cheese until stiff peaks form. This will be the cherry on top!

Step 10: Cool and Frost

Allow the cake to cool completely, then spread the frosting evenly over the top. Make it look pretty!

Step 11: Garnish

Garnish with extra coconut, almonds, and white chocolate shavings for that extra touch of elegance.

Step 12: Chill and Serve

Chill the cake for 30 minutes before slicing and serving. Enjoy your heavenly creation!

Recipe Snapshot

Pro Tips for Making Heaven on Earth Cake

  • Use ripe bananas for extra sweetness.
  • Make the layers even for better presentation.
  • Use a cold metal bowl to whip ingredients more quickly.
  • Garnish just before serving to keep it fresh.

How to Serve this Heaven on Earth Cake

  • Top with fresh berries for a burst of flavor.
  • Serve with a dollop of whipped cream or coconut cream.
  • Pair with a scoop of vanilla or almond ice cream.
  • Drizzle with chocolate or caramel sauce for extra indulgence.
  • Enjoy with a cup of herbal tea or coffee for a cozy treat.
  • Garnish with mint leaves for a refreshing touch.

Make Ahead and Storage

You can make this cake ahead and store it easily:

Storing Heaven on Earth Cake Leftovers

  • Allow the cake to cool completely.
  • Cover it tightly with plastic wrap or aluminum foil.
  • Store in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
  • For longer storage, consider freezing.

Freezing Heaven on Earth Cake

  • Wrap individual slices in plastic wrap.
  • Place wrapped slices in an airtight container or freezer bag.
  • Label with the date and freeze for up to 3 months.
  • Thaw in the refrigerator before serving.

Reheating Heaven on Earth Cake

  • Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C).
  • Place the cake on a baking sheet.
  • Cover with foil to prevent drying out.
  • Heat for about 10-15 minutes or until warmed through.

FAQs

Here’s a helpful FAQ about this recipe:

1. What is a Heaven on Earth Cake?

Heaven on Earth Cake is a delightful dessert that combines layers of moist cake, creamy filling, and often fruit or whipped cream. It’s known for its rich flavor and light texture, making it a favorite for celebrations and gatherings.

2. What are the main ingredients needed to make Heaven on Earth Cake?

To make Heaven on Earth Cake, you will need basic ingredients such as flour, sugar, eggs, baking powder, and vanilla extract for the cake. For the filling, cream cheese, whipped cream, and your choice of fruit (like strawberries or peaches) are commonly used. You can also use non-dairy substitutes if needed.

3. How do you prepare and bake a Heaven on Earth Cake?

To prepare Heaven on Earth Cake, start by mixing the dry ingredients and then adding the wet ingredients to form a batter. Pour the batter into a prepared baking pan and bake until golden brown. Once cooled, layer the cake with the creamy filling and fruit, and chill before serving for the best flavor and texture.

4. Can I customize the flavor or toppings of a Heaven on Earth Cake?

Absolutely! Heaven on Earth Cake is very versatile. You can customize the flavor by adding different extracts, such as almond or lemon, or by incorporating cocoa powder for a chocolate version. Toppings can also be varied; consider using nuts, chocolate shavings, or a drizzle of caramel for an extra touch of indulgence.

Final Thoughts

Get ready to indulge in a slice of pure bliss with this Heaven on Earth Cake! It’s a delightful treat that’s as easy to make as it is to enjoy. So gather your loved ones, whip up this moist, decadent dessert, and create sweet memories together. Trust me, every bite will transport you to dessert paradise!
